messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians could take advantage of in 2023.  
(Only federal holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday are shown; provincial holidays that create long weekends are noted where applicable.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes / Provinces |
|------|---------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20 – Feb 22** | *Family Day* (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday‑Friday long weekend |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | *Good Friday* (all provinces) | Friday‑Sunday long weekend |
| **May 22 – May 24** | *Victoria Day* (all provinces) | Monday‑Wednesday long weekend |
| **Sep 4 – Sep 6** | *Labour Day* (all provinces) | Monday‑Wednesday long weekend |
| **Oct 9 – Oct 11** | *Thanksgiving* (all provinces) | Monday‑Wednesday long weekend |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 27** | *Christmas* (all provinces) | Monday‑Wednesday long weekend |

> **Quick tip:**  
> • If you’re in a province that observes *St. Patrick’s Day* (Newfoundland & Labrador) or *St. George’s Day* (British Columbia), those days can also create a short long weekend depending on the weekday they fall on.  
> • Some provinces have *Civic Holiday* on the first Monday in August – that’s a long weekend too (Aug 7 – Aug 9).

Feel free to copy/paste the table into your holiday‑planning app!
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. We can provide the answer manually. We should respond with the list. The user didn't specify format. Provide a list of dates. Let's give them the Canadian federal public holidays that create long weekends. In Canada, long weekends typically include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (varies), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25). But long weekends are those that fall on Friday or Monday. For 2023: Jan 1 is Sunday, so no long weekend. Family Day in Ontario is Feb 20 (Monday) - long weekend. Good Friday is April 7 (Friday) - long weekend. Victoria Day is May 22 (Monday) - long weekend. Canada Day is July 1 (Saturday) - no long weekend. Labour Day is Sep 4 (Monday) - long weekend. Thanksgiving is Oct 9 (Monday) - long weekend. Remembrance Day is Nov 11 (Wednesday) - no long weekend. Christmas is Dec 25 (Monday) - long weekend. Also, there might be provincial holidays like St. Patrick's Day in Newfoundland (Mar 17) but not a federal holiday. So we can list the long weekends: Family Day (Ontario, etc.), Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas.

We can also mention that other provinces have different holidays. Provide a table.
